title: Synthesis and Structure of Unprecedented Carboxylate-bridged Heteronuclear Cr(III)-Nd(III) Complex

material_class.structural_family: carboxylate- and hydroxo-bridged Cr2Nd3 cluster cations linked by Na+ into an infinite chain

synthesis.procedure: A mixed aqueous solution of NdCl3·6H2O (1.08 g, 3.0 mmol) and sodium acetate (1.72 g, 6.0 mmol) in 20 cm3 H2O was stirred at room temperature for 10 min. An aqueous solution (10 cm3) of CrCl3·6H2O (0.53 g, 2.0 mmol) was added and stirred for 1 h, during which the color changed from green to red-purple. The reaction solution was poured onto an SP-Sephadex C-25 column and a red-purple band was eluted with 0.3 mol dm−3 NaBr. The eluate was concentrated to dryness and desalted by adding CH3OH. Red-purple crystals of 1Br were obtained by standing the solution in a refrigerator for a few days. A well-formed crystal was used for X-ray analysis; two lattice water molecules were lost during elemental analysis.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature for reaction; refrigerator for crystallization
synthesis.time: stirred 10 min then 1 h after Cr addition; crystallized for a few days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aqueous mixing followed by SP-Sephadex C-25 cation-exchange chromatography
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: elution of the red-purple band with 0.3 mol dm−3 NaBr, concentration to dryness, desalting with methanol, and crystallization in a refrigerator

properties.summary: Aqueous UV-vis spectrum of cation 1 shows two broad Cr(III) d–d bands at 551.6 and 401.8 nm (shifted to longer wavelength versus related Cr-acetate complexes) and sharp Nd(III) f–f peaks at 575.4, 523.3, and 355.2 nm. The cation is stable in water at room temperature for a few minutes; Cr(III) d–d peaks shift gradually and a highly charged polymer is detected after 20 h. Magnetic properties are discussed only as a prospective interaction, not measured.

measurements.name: UV-vis absorption maxima (Cr(III) d–d)
measurements.conditions: aqueous solution of complex 1; room temperature; two broad bands

measurements.name: UV-vis absorption maxima (Nd(III) f–f)
measurements.conditions: aqueous solution of complex 1; several sharp peaks; no shift relative to typical Nd(III)

source_locations.location: structure discussion and Figure 1–2 packing via Na+

material_class.structural_family: carboxylate- and hydroxo-bridged Cr2Nd3 cluster (chloride salt analogue of 1Br)

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same aqueous Cr/Nd acetate procedure as 1Br, except the red-purple SP-Sephadex C-25 band was eluted with 0.3 mol dm−3 NaCl. The eluate was concentrated to dryness and desalted with methanol. Elemental analysis matched [Cr2Nd3(μ-OOCCH3)6(μ-OH)6(H2O)9]Cl3·2NaCl·4H2O.
synthesis.time: stirred 10 min then 1 h after Cr addition
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aqueous mixing followed by SP-Sephadex C-25 cation-exchange chromatography
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: elution with 0.3 mol dm−3 NaCl, concentration to dryness, and desalting with methanol

properties.summary: UV-vis data are reported for aqueous cation 1 (the common Cr2Nd3 core of the Cl and Br salts): Cr(III) d–d bands at 551.6 and 401.8 nm and Nd(III) f–f peaks at 575.4, 523.3, and 355.2 nm. No separate magnetic measurements are given.
